tasks.summary: Aligned big_picture.md and README with the graph repository, dispatcher, callable graph, activationHints, and simplified command model; removed stale demo and subgraph/latch language.
Added backward-compatible workflow and graph metadata schema fields with defaults, plus focused tests for metadata-rich and invalid graph definitions.
Added structured orientation, nextAllowedCommand, helpCommand, dispatcher-ready no-focus guidance, recent context outputs, and route rendering for agent re-anchoring.
Added advanceRun plus low-level and demo advance/explain commands, kept compatibility aliases, and updated command help/tests for the canonical host-agent loop.
Ran typecheck, full tests, build, and a demo smoke through advance/explain; verified gate output includes orientation, recent context, routes, and next allowed command.
